kyoto_unagi_to_coffee.gf_detail: Ask. Charcoal-grilled eel glazed with a long-kept tare, unaju with clear soup and pickles, Basque cheesecake; no gluten information (own site; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_unagi_to_coffee.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an eel restaurant; sides include river fish, shrimp and dashimaki, and the soup is clam or eel liver (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_unagi_to_coffee.hours_raw: Tuesday–Sunday 11:00–17:00; closed Monday and some irregular days (Tabelog). The shop’s site lists 11:00–18:00, closed Monday — the Tabelog hours are used. Reservations accepted (June 2026). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 14 seats: a counter in front of the grill and several tables for two (Tabelog; October 2026). Non-smoking (Tabelog). On Matsubara-dori west of Yamatooji, right behind the river-fish shop のと正, 5 min from Keihan Gion-Shijo (own site; December 2025). Site opened August 2024 (own site).
kyoto_unagi_to_coffee.notes: [Unagi and coffee · Matsubara-dori behind のと正] A stylish 14-seat counter-and-tables café behind the old river-fish shop のと正, grilling eel over binchotan in front of you, Kansai style, with that shop’s tare — unaju from ¥3,900 — then house-roasted coffee and Basque cheesecake. Daytime only; closed Monday. Flagged: a sister concept of のと正, which is already listed.

chef_bio.background: The shop’s site says it uses the tare of のと正, kept topped up for 60 years, with eel from Shizuoka. Reviewers say it is run by のと正, a long-established river-fish shop nearby (December 2025, January 2026), and two reviewers say it was started by a daughter of that family (June 2026). Tabelog’s shop text mentions a collaboration with Kawagoe Fishery.
chef_bio.philosophy: Away from the bustle of the city, a slow, happy hour of eel, good drink and coffee roasted to match (own site).

anecdotes.text: A January 2026 diner expected so-so eel from a café with a quirky name, then watched it grilled over binchotan and was won over.
An April 2026 visitor had lunch here before the Kyo Odori dances in Miyagawa-cho.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 鰻と、COFFEE、東山区松原通大和大路西入弓矢町31-1、京阪祇園四条駅から徒歩5分、11時〜18時 (月曜定休)、60年前から追い足す「のと正」のタレ、静岡の鰻、炭火焼き、新潟産コシヒカリ、自家焙煎のスペシャルティコーヒー、うな重 上 3,900円、特上 5,200円、Premium (冷酒ミニボトル付き) 7,200円、白焼、う巻き、鮎の塩焼きなど季節の料理、宇治の玉露700円、2024年8月に公式サイト公開。食べログ: うなぎ・カフェ、火〜日 11:00〜17:00、月曜定休、14席、カード・電子マネー・QR可、Kawagoe Fisheryとのコラボ。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 備長炭で焼く関西風の鰻、のと正が営む、川魚や海老と豆などの小鉢、だし巻き、はまぐりのお吸い物、うなぎ茶漬け2,900円、バスクチーズケーキ3種。

cultural_comfort.note: Café-style counter; warm, informal service (2026 reviews).

existence.note: Tabelog listing and own site; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_tozanbo_tamanohikari.gf_detail: Ask. Kyoto kaiseki, sukiyaki and shabu-shabu, yudofu and fugu pots; no gluten information is published (Tabelog; reviews).
kyoto_tozanbo_tamanohikari.vegan_detail: Not vegan: kaiseki with fish, wagyu sukiyaki and shabu-shabu (Tabelog). A yudofu pot is one of the hot-pot choices — ask about dashi (Tabelog).
kyoto_tozanbo_tamanohikari.hours_raw: Monday–Thursday and Sunday 12:00–21:00; Friday 12:00–14:30 and 17:00–21:30; Saturday 11:30–14:30 and 17:00–21:30 (Tabelog). Reservations taken. Cards and e-money accepted; cashless only (Tabelog). 5% service charge (Tabelog). 70 seats over two floors with private rooms looking over the Kamo River; a riverside yuka terrace in season, with an indoor seat held in case of rain; wheelchair and stroller access to the riverside; non-smoking, including the terrace (Tabelog; July 2025). Insects can be a nuisance on the terrace after dark (2024 and 2026 reviews). On Pontocho north of Shijo, 2 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi or Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_tozanbo_tamanohikari.notes: [Kyoto cuisine · Pontocho, a townhouse on the Kamo yuka] A Pontocho townhouse with private rooms and a summer yuka terrace over the Kamo River, looking across to Higashiyama. Kyoto kaiseki, wagyu sukiyaki and seasonal hot pots — hamo in summer, fugu in winter — with a small-pot kaiseki at ¥6,600. Cashless; 5% service; wheelchair access to the riverside.

chef_bio.background: Run by 有限会社シーアンドディー (C&D) of Shimogyo (National Tax Agency invoice register T7130002023987), a Kyoto company whose site lists Pontocho and Kiyamachi restaurants such as 眺河 and bars. The shop serves Kyoto cuisine with Tamanohikari sake in a Pontocho townhouse (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Kyoto kaiseki and hot pots by the Kamo River.

anecdotes.text: A May 2024 guest, rained off the yuka, was given a 2nd-floor room and watched a white heron in the rain.
A February 2025 visitor ate while watching snow fall outside the window.
A July 2025 diner on a first river-terrace dinner had the Kobe beef sukiyaki and noted the terrace is non-smoking.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 東山望 TAMANOHIKARI、日本料理・しゃぶしゃぶ、京都市中京区先斗町四条上ル鍋屋町228、阪急京都河原町駅・京阪祇園四条駅から徒歩2分、月〜木・日 12:00〜21:00、金 12:00〜14:30・17:00〜21:30、土 11:30〜14:30・17:00〜21:30、予約可、カード・電子マネー可、キャッシュレスのみ、サービス料5%、70席 (1階・2階、個室)、禁煙、鴨川の床、車椅子・ベビーカーで川床へ、雨の場合は室内席も確保、玉乃光の酒、小鍋会席 (和牛すき焼き・鴨すき・とらふぐ・湯豆腐から選択、1ドリンク付き) 6,600円、京都平井牛と神戸牛の食べ比べ会席9,900円、インボイス T7130002023987 (有限会社シーアンドディー)。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): 町家、鴨川と東山の眺め、御膳ランチ (刺身、湯豆腐、ぶりの西京焼き、じゃこ山椒ご飯)、鱧しゃぶ、鮎、神戸牛のすき焼き、すき焼き御膳、床は禁煙、夜は虫が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Cashless; private rooms; riverside terrace.

kyoto_ryoriya_toki.gf_detail: Ask. Seasonal kaiseki: sashimi, clear soups, charcoal-grilled fish and meat, tempura, ochazuke; no gluten information is published (official site; reviews).
kyoto_ryoriya_toki.vegan_detail: Not vegan: kaiseki of fish, eel and meat (official site; reviews).
kyoto_ryoriya_toki.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–15:00 (last order 13:30, reservation only), dinner 17:00–22:00; closed Wednesday (Tabelog; official site). Reservations advised — often full (April 2026). Cash or cards; no e-money (official site). 16 seats: 8 at the counter, small tables and a semi-private room looking over the Takase River; non-smoking (official site; 2024–2026 reviews). Solo diners welcome at the counter (official site). On the corner of Kiyamachi and Bukkoji, about 5 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn (official site).
kyoto_ryoriya_toki.notes: [Kaiseki · Kiyamachi on the Takase River, small and seasonal] A 16-seat kaiseki-kappo on the corner of Kiyamachi and Bukkoji, sister of りょうりや 御旅屋, cooking fish and meat over charcoal in a kamado. Dinner courses from ¥7,500 or a la carte at the counter — sashimi, Lake Biwa ayu, mountain-vegetable tempura. Takase River views; often full, so book; closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: The official greeting, dated the opening on 23 August 2020, is signed by owner 原田 祐司, who runs Toki as the sibling shop of りょうりや 御旅屋 on Nishikiyamachi at Takatsuji. The name means "season".
chef_bio.philosophy: Serve each season’s best food casually and at a fair price (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal kaiseki; charcoal-grilled fish and meat.

anecdotes.text: On the fourth anniversary in August 2024, a local who walks a dog along the path outside was poured complimentary sake.
A March 2025 traveller, turned away by the full main restaurant, was sent to this sister shop.
An April 2026 guest found a "Fully Booked" sign at the door and was glad to have reserved ten days ahead.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: りょうりや 季 (TOKI)、京都河原町駅から徒歩圏内の会席・割烹店、京都市下京区市之町260-1 仏光寺角、京都河原町駅から徒歩約5分、16席 (カウンター8、テーブル8)、禁煙、現金・カード可、電子マネー不可、姉妹店「りょうりや御旅屋」、かまど (おくどさん) で肉と魚を炭火焼き、気軽に楽しめる会席料理、ディナーはアラカルトも可、夜の部コース7,500円・9,500円・11,500円、ご挨拶は店主 原田祐司 (令和2年8月23日開店)。食べログ: 12:00〜15:00 (L.O.13:30、昼は予約のみ)・17:00〜22:00、水曜定休。口コミ (2023〜2026年、英語): 高瀬川の眺め、カウンター、半個室、刺身盛り合わせ1,500円から、ホタルイカの酢味噌1,400円、京都の筍の炭火焼き1,500円、山菜の天ぷら1,400円、琵琶湖の鮎の塩焼き、めひかり、海鮮茶漬け、鱧の椀、4周年、満席が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Cards accepted; counter welcomes solo diners; book ahead.

existence.note: Official site and Tabelog listing; reviews dated through September 2026. Tabelog still carries a 2023 closing notice, contradicted by the site and later reviews.

kyoto_yohei_sushi_kiyamachi.gf_detail: Ask. Edomae sushi with red-vinegar rice; small dishes such as eel chawanmushi; no gluten information is published (TableCheck; reviews).
kyoto_yohei_sushi_kiyamachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an Edomae sushi course (Tabelog).
kyoto_yohei_sushi_kiyamachi.hours_raw: Lunch 11:00–15:00 (last order 14:00), dinner 18:00–22:00 (last order 20:30); closed Wednesday (Tabelog). Reservations taken; allergies or dislikes affecting two or more dishes are treated as a cancellation — say so when booking (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR accepted (Tabelog). 10% service charge (Tabelog). 26 seats: a counter and private rooms for 2 and 4; non-smoking (Tabelog; TableCheck). Large windows on the Kamo River (Tabelog; September 2026). On the ground floor of HANAMIYA on Kiyamachi above Matsubara, 5 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi or Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_yohei_sushi_kiyamachi.notes: [Sushi · Kiyamachi by the Kamo, Edomae courses] A new Edomae sushi counter in a hotel building on Kiyamachi, with solid-wood fittings and big windows on the Kamo River. Red-vinegar rice and omakase courses from ¥8,800 to ¥27,500 at lunch and dinner. Private rooms; 10% service; closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Opened in May 2026 on the ground floor of HANAMIYA (Tabelog). A May 2026 reviewer calls it a new restaurant of the Kyoto Saeki group, opened with a hotel’s backing; a September 2026 reviewer says the chef comes from an Edomae sushi background.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 couple were the only guests on a rainy day before the hotel had opened.
A September 2026 diner singled out the deep-red whale nigiri.
A June 2026 diner found the taste almost the same as at Saeki.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 京都 与兵衛、寿司・日本料理・海鮮、京都市下京区木屋町通松原上る三丁目天王町155-1 HANAMIYA 1F、京都河原町駅・祇園四条駅から徒歩5分、昼11:00〜15:00 (L.O.14:00)・夜18:00〜22:00 (L.O.20:30)、水曜定休、予約可、アレルギーや苦手な食材がコースの2品以上に及ぶ場合はキャンセル扱い、カード・電子マネー・QR可、サービス料10%、26席、個室 (2名・4名)、2026年5月1日オープン、鴨川を望む大きな窓、おまかせ8,800円、昼のコース16,500円 (3品・握り10貫・甘味)・27,500円 (4品・握り12貫・甘味)。TableCheck: 鮨屋与兵衛 京都、江戸前寿司、赤酢の酢飯、クロマグロ、いわし。口コミ (2026年、英語): 京都の佐伯グループの新店、ホテルの1階、鰻の茶碗蒸し、鯨の握り、江戸前出身の職人。

cultural_comfort.note: Cards and QR accepted; private rooms; 10% service.

kyoto_pontocho_tanrakuya_toriume.gf_detail: Ask. Yakitori comes with house tare or mizu-shio (salt water) (official site); the menu also has chicken-broth udon and grilled rice balls (2024–25 reviews). No gluten information.
kyoto_pontocho_tanrakuya_toriume.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a yakitori house built on chicken broth — even the appetizer is tofu in chicken broth (April 2025).
kyoto_pontocho_tanrakuya_toriume.hours_raw: Mon and Wed–Sun 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:00); closed Tuesday and every other Wednesday (Tabelog); the official site says closed Tuesday and alternate Mondays or Wednesdays; closing times may vary (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, incl. by phone on the day (Tabelog; August 2026). Appetizer charge ¥500 per person, included in courses (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「お通し500円/人（コースご利用の場合は料金に含まれてます）」); a July 2026 bill showed ¥550. Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 24 seats: 8 at the counter, 16 at tables (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). English menu (Tabelog). Pontocho Building 1F, Pontocho south of Sanjo, 3 min from Keihan Sanjo (Tabelog). Opened 11 April 2012 (Tabelog).
kyoto_pontocho_tanrakuya_toriume.notes: [Yakitori · Pontocho, since 2012] A small charcoal yakitori house at the Sanjo end of Pontocho, grilling Tanba chicken over Tosa binchotan with house tare or salt water, plus rare cuts like comb, a pâté-rich simmered liver and a chicken-broth finale of fried rice balls or udon. Over 20 local sakes. Good-value courses from ¥3,960; closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and the official site: a yakitori restaurant opened in April 2012 in Pontocho, grilling carefully chosen chicken over Tosa binchotan, with local sake selected by a kikisake-shi (sake sommelier).

anecdotes.text: A May 2025 diner tried chicken comb for the first time and found the simmered liver as rich as a pâté.
An April 2025 visitor would travel from Osaka just for the fried rice balls soaked in chicken broth.
A February 2026 diner suggests ordering à la carte rather than a course to try the unusual dishes.

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog); the courses are the easy way in.

kyoto_matsunaga_wagyu_kujo.gf_detail: Ask. Shio-grilled cuts are on the menu alongside tare, miso and sukiyaki, katsu sandwiches, ramen and tempura (official site); no gluten information.
kyoto_matsunaga_wagyu_kujo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a wagyu yakiniku house; salads and grilled vegetables exist but come with beef courses (official site).
kyoto_matsunaga_wagyu_kujo.hours_raw: Mon, Wed–Sun and holidays 17:00–23:00 (last orders food 22:00, drinks 22:30); closed Tuesday; days may change (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and QR (PayPay, WeChat Pay); no e-money (Tabelog). 36 seats: counter and private rooms for up to 10, some upstairs (Tabelog; February 2025). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Menus in English, Chinese and Korean; English-speaking staff (Tabelog). A machiya on cobbled Shinbashi-dori near Tatsumi Shrine, 3 min from Gion-Shijo (Tabelog; February 2025). Opened 4 January 2025 (Tabelog).
kyoto_matsunaga_wagyu_kujo.notes: [Wagyu yakiniku · Gion Shinbashi, since 2025] A machiya yakiniku house on cobbled Shinbashi-dori, opened in January 2025 to serve Shimane's award-winning Matsunaga Wagyu: courses that run from lobster bisque and seared wagyu nigiri through salt, tare and miso grills to sukiyaki, a wagyu katsu sandwich and ramen. Counter or private rooms; English-speaking staff. Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Per 2025 reviews: the chef handled meat at popular steakhouses such as Morton's in Tokyo and at hotel restaurants. Per the official site: Matsunaga Wagyu is mainly descended from the bull Dai-7 Itozakura and won the Prime Minister's Prize (2008) and national honour prizes (2020, 2022, 2023).

anecdotes.text: A February 2025 diner liked that the lobster bisque was kept light to let the shrimp on top shine.
A February 2025 visitor arrived at dusk with the lanterns lit and was led upstairs to a private room.
A July 2026 diner finished the Meat Feast course completely stuffed.

cultural_comfort.note: English, Chinese and Korean menus with photos; English-speaking staff (Tabelog).

kyoto_bar_orange_pontocho.gf_detail: Ask. Mainly cocktails; food includes homemade smoked dishes and pizza (Tabelog); no gluten information.
kyoto_bar_orange_pontocho.vegan_detail: Ask. A cocktail bar; snacks such as smoked nuts and homemade chocolate (April 2025) and smoked dishes and pizza (Tabelog) — no vegan information.
kyoto_bar_orange_pontocho.hours_raw: Daily 14:00–1:00; open all year (Tabelog; the listing also carries an old notice of shorter emergency-period hours). Reservations accepted; whole-bar hire for 20–50 (Tabelog). Cash only — no cards or e-money (Tabelog). Service charge ¥330 (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「330円」). 42 seats: 7 at the counter, 8 table, 8 sofa and 18 on the terrace (Tabelog). Smoking allowed (Tabelog). Emerald Kaikan 4F, Pontocho by the Kamo River, 3 min from Keihan Sanjo (Tabelog; April 2025).
kyoto_bar_orange_pontocho.notes: [Cocktail bar · Pontocho, Kamo River terrace] A fourth-floor bar on the Kamo River side of Pontocho with a sofa terrace over the river — kotatsu and blankets in winter, breezes in summer — open from 14:00 to 1:00. Fruit and gin cocktails made to your taste, smoked nuts, homemade chocolate, smoked dishes and pizza. Cash only; ¥330 service charge; smoking allowed.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a bar with Kamo River terrace seating, homemade smoked dishes and pizza, and a wide drink list.

anecdotes.text: A January 2024 visitor sipped coffee under a terrace kotatsu, sheltered from the wind, while friends worked through the cocktails.
A May 2022 visitor described a preference and got a gently sweet custom cocktail; blankets were handed out on the chilly terrace.
On a June 2026 summer night the staff dealt quickly with bugs drawn to the terrace lights.

kyoto_beans_tei.notes: [Coffee stand · Takakura by Nishiki] A tiny self-roasting bean shop a step from Nishiki Market, with jars of beans along the counter and a strong cup to take away for ¥280 — ¥20 less if you skip the lid. Beans ground to order, from house blends to Ethiopian single origins. Cash only; closed Tuesday and Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per reviewers: a self-roasting coffee bean shop near the Nishiki Market exit and Daimaru, selling blends and single origins with take-away coffee; a December 2025 reviewer had heard it was featured on the NHK programme 72 Hours. An August 2026 regular describes a lively, cheerful owner, often there at weekends and in the evening.

anecdotes.text: A June 2025 Sunday visitor learned the iced coffee is ¥20 cheaper without a lid and drank it strolling the neighbourhood.
A December 2025 guest arrived ten minutes before take-away began at noon, and watched a steady line buying beans.
A July 2026 customer described tastes to the staff and was steered to the Mild Blend, good hot or iced.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: コーヒースタンド、中京区高倉通錦小路下ル (番地の表示なし)、阪急烏丸駅・地下鉄四条駅、月・木〜日 11:00〜19:00、火・水休み、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、禁煙、テイクアウト、公式サイトあり。口コミ (2025年1月〜2026年8月、英語): 錦市場の出口と大丸のそば、自家焙煎の豆の店、カウンターに豆の大瓶、立ち飲みのコーナー、持ち帰りのコーヒーはホットかアイスのブラックで1サイズ、ホット280円、アイス380円、ふたなしで20円引き、豆はブレンドからシングルオリジンまで (Rich Honey Blend 100g 約800円、Mild Blend、エチオピア イルガチェフェ G2)、挽いてもらえる、ドリップバッグ、持ち帰りは12時から (2025年12月)、NHK の番組で紹介されたとの声、明るい店主 (2026年8月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Cash only; counter take-away; quick.

kyoto_tempura_gen_kiyamachi.gf_detail: Not GF: wheat-batter tempura over rice with a soy-based sauce (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_tempura_gen_kiyamachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: shrimp, anago, kisu and scallop tempura, egg, miso soup (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_tempura_gen_kiyamachi.hours_raw: Monday, Tuesday and Friday–Sunday 11:30–14:30 and 17:00–20:30; Thursday 17:00–20:30; closed Wednesday (Tabelog). Same prices at lunch and dinner (August 2025). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards and QR (Tabelog; November 2025). Eight counter seats and one table at the back (May and November 2025). 1F of the Oriental Kaikan on Kiyamachi, just over Sanjo Ohashi; 2 min walk from Sanjo Stn (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_tempura_gen_kiyamachi.notes: [Tempura · Kiyamachi-Sanjo counter] A small counter by the Kamo run by a couple, frying generous tendon to order: two big shrimp and vegetables with a soft egg, or the limited seafood bowl with an anago spilling over the rim. Light batter, free large rice and refills of miso soup and pickles, same price day and night. Closed Wednesday; no Thursday lunch.

chef_bio.background: Per reviewers: a tempura counter of about eight seats on Kiyamachi run by a couple (September and October 2025), frying in oil blended by Yamanaka Aburaten, a Kyoto oil shop of nearly 200 years (August 2025), under a large painting by Daruma Shoten (May 2025).

anecdotes.text: A May 2025 diner took the middle counter seat, facing a large, humorous and slightly eerie painting by Daruma Shoten.
An October 2025 guest, there with a parent, found the couple running the counter perfectly in step, the scallops still rare inside.
A November 2025 visitor from Kanto found the dipping sauce not sweet enough and the batter thicker than preferred.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 天ぷら、中京区木屋町通石屋町126 オリエンタル会館 1F、三条駅から125m、月・火・金〜日 11:30〜14:30、17:00〜20:30、木 17:00〜20:30、水曜休み、予約可、カード・QR 可。口コミ (2025年5月〜2026年7月、英語): 夫婦で営む (2025年9・10月)、カウンター8席ほどと奥にテーブル1卓、Yamanaka Aburaten の油、天丼1,600円、特製天丼 A・B 各1,980円、数量限定の海鮮天丼3,580円 (穴子一本、海老、きす、帆立、半熟卵)、天ぷら定食に抹茶塩、ご飯大盛り無料、味噌汁と漬物のおかわり自由、昼も夜も同じ値段、Daruma Shoten の大きな絵、つゆの甘さが足りず衣が厚めとの声 (2025年11月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Small counter; cards and QR; same prices day and night.

kyoto_tamago_ga_saki_ka.gf_detail: Ask. Salt skewers are possible, but the tare, gyoza and some side dishes are wheat or soy-based (2025 reviews).
kyoto_tamago_ga_saki_ka.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chicken yakitori, egg dishes, chicken sashimi (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_tamago_ga_saki_ka.hours_raw: Tue–Sun and holidays 17:00–05:00; closed Mondays (Tabelog). Bookings by phone from 16:00 (Tabelog). No cover charge (Tabelog Japanese original 「チャージ料なし」). Cards and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). 27 seats, counter and sofas; heated tobacco only in a designated area; English menu; children welcome (Tabelog). Orders by QR code or tablet (May and October 2025 reviews). A free dish for posting a review (June 2026 review). On Higashi-Kiyamachi south of Sanjo, 5 min from Sanjo or Kawaramachi (Tabelog).
kyoto_tamago_ga_saki_ka.notes: [Yakitori · Kiyamachi] A bright, casual yakitori bar on Kiyamachi grilling cheap charcoal skewers — about ¥300 for two — with fluffy dashimaki and tsukune three ways, until 5 am. About ¥2,000–4,000.

chef_bio.background: Opened 6 October 2023 (Tabelog). A young team (October 2025 review); skewers grilled to order (June 2026 review).

anecdotes.text: A March 2025 diner came for a casual meal and found well-priced skewers, slightly small for trying many, and a fluffy but firm dashimaki.
A May 2025 diner tasted the three tsukune — cheese, plain and with raw egg — and came to use points but forgot to.
On a Sunday night in October 2025, with little else open on Kiyamachi, a diner found jazz playing and ¥308 pairs of skewers, gently grilled.
An October 2025 pair found the skewers small and the place geared to overseas visitors.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 卵がさきか鶏がさきか、焼き鳥、中京区東木屋町通四条上ル材木町182-1 木屋町不動ビル1F、三条駅・河原町駅から徒歩5分、火〜日・祝 17:00〜翌5:00、月曜休み、電話予約は16:00から、チャージ料なし、カード・PayPay 可、電子マネー不可、27席、加熱式たばこのみ喫煙所、英語メニュー、子ども可、2023年10月6日オープン。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): 2本で300円ほどの炭火焼き鳥、ねぎまと皮308円、つくね3種572円、だし巻き、地鶏のむね肉の刺身、焼きなす、ユッケ、餃子、QR コードやタブレットで注文、口コミ投稿で1品サービス、朝5時まで。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu; QR/tablet ordering (Tabelog; 2025 reviews).

kyoto_rokkaku_887.gf_detail: Ask. Pizza, pasta, baguette toasts and fried dishes are wheat; ask about the rest (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_rokkaku_887.vegan_detail: Not vegan: caviar, horse tartare, lamb tsukune, pork ragù pizza (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_rokkaku_887.hours_raw: Daily 17:00–01:00; hours may change (Tabelog). Bookings taken (Tabelog). JCB cards and e-money; no QR (Tabelog). Standing only, about 7–8 places at the counter; non-smoking (Tabelog; October 2025 review). Down a corridor on the 1st floor of the 都会館 building on Kiyamachi, 4 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi (Tabelog; March 2026 review).
kyoto_rokkaku_887.notes: [Standing Italian bar · Kiyamachi] A tiny, dim standing counter down a Kiyamachi corridor where the chef of ricetta 8.7 cooks inventive small plates — horse tartare toast, lamb tsukune, caviar, pizzas and pasta — with a sommelier's wines by the glass, until 1 am. About ¥4,000–8,000.

chef_bio.background: Opened 30 June 2025 (Tabelog). A standing bar from the chef of ricetta 8.7 in Karasuma Oike (March and April 2026 reviews), cooking in front of guests with a steam oven (March and April 2026 reviews). A sommelier picks wines (August 2026 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Creative Italian small plates with wine.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 diner who doubted white wine was guided to a glass to suit, and insisted the horse yukhoe on buttered toast was one each, not for sharing.
A March 2026 diner on a business trip found a young crowd drinking alone and an owner who was fun to talk to.
A February 2026 return visitor liked the pizza but found the new staff inexperienced compared with the first visit in October 2025.
An October 2026 diner came back for the "Buldog Pork Mexiko" pizza of pork ragù, red cheddar, spinach salsa and chimichurri mayo.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ロッカクハッテンナナ (Rokkaku 887)、イタリアン・立ち飲み、中京区材木町184 都会館1F、阪急河原町駅から徒歩4分、毎日 17:00〜翌1:00 (変更の可能性あり)、予約可、カード (JCB)・電子マネー可、QR 不可、禁煙、立ち飲み、2025年6月30日オープン。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): Karasuma Oike の ricetta 8.7 のシェフの立ち飲み、キャビア、海老のパテ600円、ラムのつくね900円、締めのナッツのパスタ1,200円、シャンパン900円、グラスワイン600〜900円、馬肉のタルタルのバゲット、ピザとパスタ、ソムリエ。

cultural_comfort.note: Standing counter; staff help choose wine.

kyoto_kagirinakifuku_gion.gf_detail: Ask. Rice-mochi daifuku, but the meat fillings are soy-sauce seasoned and the soba is buckwheat-and-wheat (2025 reviews; Tabelog).
kyoto_kagirinakifuku_gion.vegan_detail: Not vegan: beef, pork and chicken fillings (own store; 2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_kagirinakifuku_gion.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 18:00–23:00 (food L.O. 22:30); closed Sundays and holidays (Tabelog). A March 2025 review gives 15:00–23:00, until sold out. Takeaway, eat-in and delivery; frozen gift boxes by mail (Tabelog; own store; December 2025 review). Cards, e-money and QR accepted (Tabelog). Non-smoking; dogs welcome; children welcome (Tabelog). 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_kagirinakifuku_gion.notes: [Meat daifuku · Gion] A small Gion shop selling a new kind of daifuku: soft, slightly sweet mochi around beef shigure, ginger pork or teriyaki chicken, about ¥550–600 each, to take away or send as gifts, plus a standing counter for beef shigure soba. Open evenings.

chef_bio.background: Opened 19 December 2024 (Tabelog; June 2025 review). Courteous owner (July 2025 review). Sells online and by subscription too (own store).
chef_bio.philosophy: "あなたの心にかぎりなき福を" — boundless good fortune in your heart (own store).

anecdotes.text: A February 2025 passer-by bought all three — chicken teriyaki ¥450, pork ginger ¥500, beef shigure ¥550 — and liked the beef best.
A December 2025 reviewer received six frozen daifuku from relatives as a year-end gift.
Another December 2025 buyer found the microwave timing tricky and ¥600 a lot for the size.

cultural_comfort.note: Takeaway counter.

kyoto_yakitori_kanazawa_rokkaku.gf_detail: Ask. Mostly salt-grilled skewers, but tare skewers, kara-age and rice bowls are not (2019–2026 reviews).
kyoto_yakitori_kanazawa_rokkaku.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chicken yakitori, wagyu and pork skewers (2019–2026 reviews).
kyoto_yakitori_kanazawa_rokkaku.hours_raw: Daily 12:00–22:30 (L.O. 22:00) (Tabelog); Tabelog adds that lunch service has ended, but an April 2026 diner had a lunch rice bowl at 2 pm. Bookings taken; when busy, about 90 minutes a visit (Tabelog; September 2019 review). One drink per person (Tabelog Japanese original 「ワンドリンク制」). Cards (Visa, Master), e-money and QR (Tabelog). 11 seats — 7 at the counter, a table of 4; non-smoking; takeaway (Tabelog). Near UNIQLO Kawaramachi, 7 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi (Tabelog; April 2026 review).
kyoto_yakitori_kanazawa_rokkaku.notes: [Yakitori · Rokkaku] A tiny 11-seat yakitori counter near Shinkyogoku grilling Kyoto red jidori over binchotan, mostly with salt; omakase sets of skewers, and rice bowls at midday. Third shop of a Yamashina yakitori. About ¥3,000–5,000.

chef_bio.background: Opened 1 September 2016 as the third shop of 焼鳥かなざわ of Yamashina (Tabelog). A man grilling with two young staff (September 2021 review); a friendly owner (July 2022 review).
chef_bio.philosophy: Morning-fresh Kyo Akajidori, raised about 150 days on pesticide-free feed, over Kishu binchotan (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: A Yamashina regular who heard of the new city branch (September 2019) was asked to keep to about 90 minutes when busy, and watched it fill up.
In September 2021 a diner who had found it too crowded to enter alone finally slipped in for the five-skewer omakase and the seseri.
An April 2026 holiday visitor got a seat at 2 pm for the yakitori and kara-age rice bowls with a rich chicken soup.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 焼鳥 かなざわ 六角店、焼き鳥・居酒屋・鶏料理、中京区桜之町406-21 白鳥ビル、阪急河原町駅から徒歩7分、毎日 12:00〜22:30 (L.O. 22:00)、ランチ営業は終了の記載、予約可、ワンドリンク制、カード (VISA・Master)・電子マネー・QR 可、11席 (カウンター7、テーブル4)、禁煙、テイクアウト、2016年9月1日オープン、Yamashina の「焼鳥かなざわ」の3号店、朝びきの Kyo Akajidori をKishu の備長炭で (紹介文、英訳)。口コミ (2018〜2026年、英語): 塩焼き中心、せせり、レバー、砂肝、ハツ、つくね、京都の豚、黒毛和牛、おまかせ5本1,300円、おぼろ豆腐500円、混雑時は90分ほど、昼の焼き鳥丼と唐揚げ丼と鶏のスープ (2026年4月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Small counter; many overseas guests (August 2023 review).

kyoto_suehiro_fugu_kiyamachi.gf_detail: Ask. Fugu sashimi with house ponzu, fugu kara-age, grilled fugu, hot pot and zosui; no gluten information (Tabelog).
kyoto_suehiro_fugu_kiyamachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fugu restaurant — sashimi, fried, grilled and hot-pot fugu, shirako (Tabelog).
kyoto_suehiro_fugu_kiyamachi.hours_raw: 17:00–22:00 daily (L.O. food 21:00, drinks 21:30); closed on irregular days, and may close over New Year and in summer (Tabelog). Reservations recommended so fish can be bought and prepared to time; give a daytime phone number or the name of your hotel (Tabelog). No service charge (Tabelog, original なし). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 38 seats, a counter and private rooms; non-smoking, smoking on the balcony (Tabelog; September 2025). On Kiyamachi south of Matsubara by the Takase river, just north of the west end of Gojo bridge, 7 min from Keihan Kiyomizu-Gojo (Tabelog).
kyoto_suehiro_fugu_kiyamachi.notes: [Fugu · Kiyamachi by the Takase, since 1949] A third-generation fugu restaurant on the Takase river near Gojo bridge, with a counter for solo diners and private rooms: tessa sashimi with house daidai ponzu, kara-age, rare grilled fugu and tecchiri hot pot finished as zosui — the full course ¥11,000 — plus shirako in winter and hire-zake. No service charge.

chef_bio.chef_name: 上田 路実 (reading not sourced)
chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s shop text says the restaurant was founded in 1949 and has served fugu for three generations. Tabelog’s invoice number T8810003331402 is registered to an individual, 上田 路実 (NTA register).
chef_bio.philosophy: Fugu is rested for over half a day after preparing to bring out its taste; reservations let the shop time its buying and preparation (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: A September 2025 visitor who knows the owner finally came, alone, and ate the Ume course of sashimi, grilled fugu and zosui at the counter.
A November 2026 visitor is taken here every year by two senior colleagues after an industry event in Kyoto, and praises the hire-zake.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 末廣、ふぐ・鍋・海鮮、下京区木屋町通松原下る材木町430、京阪清水五条駅から徒歩7分、毎日 17:00〜22:00 (L.O.料理21:00、飲物21:30)、不定休、年末年始と夏季休業あり、サービス料なし、カード・電子マネー・QR可、38席、個室あり、禁煙 (バルコニーで喫煙可)、高瀬川沿い、五条大橋西詰の北、1949年創業、三代続くふぐ料理、さばいてから半日以上寝かせる、完熟の橙を搾り6か月以上寝かせた自家製ポン酢、末廣コース11,000円 (てっさ、唐揚げ、焼きふぐ、てっちり)、てっさ3,000円、てっちり4,200円、焼きふぐ3,600円、ふぐ雑炊980円、冬季の白子、適格請求書 T8810003331402 (上田 路実)。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 梅コース、カウンターで一人でも、ひれ酒、白子。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter or private rooms; the shop asks for a daytime phone number or hotel name when booking.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through November 2026.

kyoto_gion_yamabun_aokian.gf_detail: Ask. Kyoto courses built on rich dashi, with seasonal vegetables and fish; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_gion_yamabun_aokian.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the cooking is built on dashi, with fish in the courses (Tabelog).
kyoto_gion_yamabun_aokian.hours_raw: 12:00–14:00 and 17:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:00) daily (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Service charge 10% (Tabelog, original サービス料10%). Cards: JCB and AMEX only; no e-money (Tabelog). 32 seats in private rooms for 2 to 20 (Tabelog). Designated smoking area (Tabelog). In an old Kyoto townhouse with a small garden just off Hanamikoji, south of Ichiriki, 4 min from Keihan Gion-Shijo (Tabelog; July 2026). One January 2025 diner found the rooms cold in winter.
kyoto_gion_yamabun_aokian.notes: [Kyoto cooking · Gion south of Ichiriki, a townhouse with private rooms] A homely Gion townhouse with a small garden and private rooms for 2 to 20, serving dashi-rich Kyoto courses from about ¥3,000 to all-you-can-drink sake courses at ¥6,000–10,500 — a favourite for business dinners and parties. 10% service charge; JCB and AMEX only.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s shop text describes a relaxed, homely place known for good, reasonably priced Kyoto food. An October 2025 regular, back after six years, was glad to see the same head chef.
chef_bio.philosophy: Kyoto dishes that bring out the ingredients with plenty of dashi, served without pretension (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: At a January 2025 work New Year party, the sake fans at the table cheered when the drink list arrived.
An October 2025 regular back after six years, who had ordered the osechi before, found eating in quite different and was glad the head chef was still there.

Reservations accepted, one course per person (Tabelog). Cards incl. UnionPay; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 7 counter seats (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). kyoto_sushi_numoto_gion.notes: [Sushi · Gion near Yasaka Shrine, a seven-seat counter] A seven-seat counter on an upper floor of a Gion building, where the owner buys at Kyoto’s market, takes tuna from Toyosu and makes Edomae sushi on Kyoto rice — a ¥19,800 omakase of small dishes, nigiri and seasonal ice cream, with a children’s menu. One course per person; closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s shop text says the owner visits Kyoto’s central market to choose seasonal fish and has tuna delivered from Toyosu; wines are picked by a sommelier and sake by a sake-diploma holder. A February 2026 diner saw the chef working solo without a break.

anecdotes.text: A February 2026 pair began with seiko crab and shirako on the ¥19,800 course, added ikura, and left with a gift of sesame from a Shijo shop.

kyoto_miyagawacho_saka.gf_detail: Ask. À la carte seafood, meat and vegetables, with pasta to finish (official site; 2025–26 reviews); no gluten information. The chef adapts dishes to requests (August 2025; September 2026).
kyoto_miyagawacho_saka.vegan_detail: Ask. Seafood and meat lead, but seasonal vegetables are a focus and the chef cooks to request (official site; August 2025); no vegan information.
kyoto_miyagawacho_saka.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 17:00–22:00 (last orders food 21:00, drinks 21:30; last entry 21:00 on 1F, 20:00 on 2F); lunch from 12:00 by reservation for 4 or more; closed Sunday (or the last day of a long weekend) and two irregular Mondays a month (Tabelog; official site). Reservations accepted; the 2F private rooms serve courses only (Tabelog). Charges: coperto ¥880, service 10%, 2F private room ¥5,000 per room (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「コペルト￥８８０ サービス料１０％ ２階個室料１部屋￥５、０００」). Children only in the 2F rooms (Tabelog). A former teahouse in Miyagawacho, 5 min from Gion-Shijo or Kiyomizu-Gojo (Tabelog). Opened 12 May 2010 (Tabelog).
kyoto_miyagawacho_saka.notes: [Italian–French kappo · Miyagawacho, since 2010] A hidden counter in a former teahouse in the Miyagawacho geisha district, cooking seasonal fish, meat and Kyoto vegetables with Italian and French technique and finishing with pasta — karasumi, monkfish liver, truffled gratin, bottarga pasta. À la carte at the counter, omakase courses in the tatami rooms upstairs. Coperto ¥880 plus 10% service; closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and the official site: a Western-style kappo based on Italian and French cooking, opened in May 2010 in a building that keeps the front of a former Miyagawacho teahouse.
chef_bio.philosophy: Seasonal seafood, and domestic vegetables and meat wherever possible (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Italian–French dishes à la carte; pasta to finish.

anecdotes.text: An August 2025 diner found the owner happy to cook from the day’s recommended ingredients to order.
A December 2024 family with children took a private room upstairs and saw a maiko on the way.
A March 2026 diner urges ordering à la carte and warns the alley is a bit hard to find.

kyoto_sushi_kappo_yamabiko.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: tempura comes with every lunch set and casual course, alongside nama-fu dengaku and oden (2025–26 reviews).

kyoto_sushi_kappo_yamabiko.hours_raw: Mon, Tue and Fri–Sun 12:00–14:00 and 17:00–22:00; closed Wednesday and Thursday; hours may change (Tabelog). kyoto_sushi_kappo_yamabiko.notes: [Sushi kappo · opposite Kyoto Ebisu Shrine] A long-running local sushi kappo on Yamato-oji, away from the tourist stretch, packed at lunch for a ¥2,500 set of small dishes, fresh tempura, nigiri and red miso soup. In the evening, a casual course around ¥4,300 or à la carte: hamo in season, miso dengaku, whale bacon, simmered whelk. Book ahead; closed Wednesday and Thursday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviews: a sushi kappo on Yamato-oji south of Shijo, opposite Kyoto Ebisu Shrine, reviewed since 2008.

anecdotes.text: A March 2025 diner came for lunch during the Ebessan festival across the road and came back for dinner the same day.
An April 2026 regular arrived just before opening and still only just got a counter seat.
A July 2026 Gion Matsuri visitor came for hamo, served fresh and steaming from the pot.

kyoto_gion_kitazato.vegan_detail: Not vegan: sashimi, beef tendon, mentaiko omelette and dashi-simmered dishes (2024–25 reviews).
kyoto_gion_kitazato.hours_raw: Mon and Wed–Sun 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:30); closed Tuesday; may change (Tabelog). kyoto_gion_kitazato.notes: [Kyoto home cooking and sake · Gion south] A long-loved house restaurant just off Hanamikoji with a counter and tatami rooms, serving gently seasoned Kyoto dishes — braised beef tendon, the signature grilled yam, sashimi platters, nama-fu dengaku, seasonal fish — with a deep sake list until 23:00. À la carte or courses; cash only; closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviews: a Japanese restaurant in a house on the south side of Gion, reviewed since at least 2018; one January 2025 diner was returning after 15 years.
chef_bio.specialty: Grilled yam; sashimi platters; Kyoto home-style dishes with sake.

anecdotes.text: A February 2024 group came on Setsubun night, with hyottoko dancers performing out front.
A September 2023 party of four was offered individual plates for a shared sashimi platter.
A January 2025 diner came back after 15 years and found chatting with the chef at the counter the best part.

kyoto_kyoryori_kamogawa.notes: [Kyoto kaiseki · Bukkoji, since 2018] A quiet Kyoto-cuisine restaurant near Shijo-Karasuma with a counter and private rooms, popular for business lunches and groups: hamo kaiseki in summer, fugu in winter, duck hot pot year-round, and good-value lunch sets from soba to the ¥2,500 Miyabi. A vegetarian course on request. No service charge.

roles: Head chef (unnamed), 30 years in Japanese cuisine (Tabelog)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a Kyoto-cuisine restaurant opened in March 2018 whose head chef has 30 years of experience in Japanese cooking, sourcing seasonal ingredients from across the country.

An October 2026 organiser praised how smoothly a last-minute change in numbers and the group bill were handled.

kyoto_kitchen_norita.gf_detail: Not GF: pizza, pasta and cheesecake (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_kitchen_norita.vegan_detail: Not vegan: prosciutto, salsiccia and cheese through the menu; a steamed vegetable salad and pickles may suit — ask (2024–2025 reviews).
kyoto_kitchen_norita.hours_raw: Wednesday–Sunday, holidays and the day before a holiday 17:30–23:00 (last order 22:00); closed Monday and Tuesday, open on a holiday with the closing day moved (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and e-money (IC, iD, QUICPay); no QR (Tabelog). 22 seats: 6 at the counter, 16 at tables; whole-shop hire for 14 or more, up to 20 (Tabelog). Non-smoking; smoking on the terrace (Tabelog). Children welcome (Tabelog). A white, glass-fronted house down an alley beside a hair salon at Fuyacho-Sanjo; 10 min walk from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog). Opened 7 September 2011 (Tabelog).
kyoto_kitchen_norita.notes: [Italian · Fuyacho-Sanjo alley] A bright, white little house down a side alley, run by a husband and wife: carpaccio, prosciutto, oven-baked tomatoes under melted cheeses and a Kujo-negi pizza, with wine and a homely welcome for solo diners. When busy, one cook means waits between dishes. Dinner only; closed Monday and Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a cosy, glass-fronted restaurant down a side street by a hair salon at Fuyacho-Sanjo, run by a husband-and-wife team and designed to welcome solo diners; opened 7 September 2011.
chef_bio.philosophy: Dishes that bring out the best of the ingredients (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: A September 2024 guest stopping in for a light drink worked through pickles, prosciutto, oven-baked tomatoes and a Kujo-negi pizza, praising every vegetable.
A May 2025 pair walked in on spec and were promptly seated at the counter for prosciutto, salad, pizza and mushroom ajillo.
A July 2026 diner after the Kyoto Culture Museum found everything good but waited a long time between dishes, the owner cooking alone.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: イタリアン・ダイニングバー、中京区麩屋町通三条下ル白壁町438、市役所前駅から徒歩10分、水〜日・祝・祝前日 17:30〜23:00 (L.O.22:00)、月・火休み (祝日は営業し休みをずらす)、予約可、カード (VISA・Master・JCB・AMEX・Diners)・電子マネー (交通系IC・iD・QUICPay) 可、QR 不可、22席 (カウンター6、テーブル16)、14名以上で貸切可、禁煙 (テラスで喫煙可)、子ども可、2011年9月7日開店、麩屋町三条の美容室の横の路地を入ったガラス張りの店、夫婦で営む、一人でも入りやすい。口コミ (2017年1月〜2026年7月、英語): 白い建物、カルパッチョ、自家製ピクルス、スペインの生ハム、トマトのチーズオーブン焼き、蒸し野菜のサラダ、九条ねぎとサルシッチャのピザ、きのこのアヒージョ、オイルパスタ、アールグレイのバスクチーズケーキ、カッサータ、塩ゆず酒、店主一人で調理し料理が出るまで待ったとの声 (2026年7月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Small alley restaurant; solo-friendly; cards and IC.

kyoto_man_in_the_moon_gion.gf_detail: Not GF: beer, battered fish and chips (2022–2026 reviews).
kyoto_man_in_the_moon_gion.vegan_detail: Ask. A drinks-first pub; food noted is nachos and fish and chips (2022; September 2026).
kyoto_man_in_the_moon_gion.hours_raw: Monday–Thursday and Sunday 14:30–24:00; Friday and Saturday 14:30–1:00 (Tabelog). No cover charge (Tabelog original チャージ料なし); pay at the counter as you order (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX) and IC; no QR (Tabelog). 36 seats at the counter and sofas (Tabelog). Smoking allowed, with separate smoking and non-smoking areas (Tabelog; October 2024). Live music and sports on TV; English menu; English-speaking staff (Tabelog; 2023–2026 reviews). On Shinbashi-dori east of Yamatooji; 6 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_man_in_the_moon_gion.notes: [Irish pub · Gion Shinbashi] A Dublin-style corner pub in Gion with eight to ten draught taps, a long whisky shelf, sports on the TV and a crowd mostly from overseas — no cover charge, pay as you order. Good fish and chips. Smoking allowed in part of the room. Open from 14:30 until midnight, 1 a.m. at weekends.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: the third Man in the Moon, after Kyoto Station and Karasuma, from the people behind the British pub Pig & Whistle, open since 1986; a no-charge, cash-on-counter Irish pub styled on a Dublin corner pub with ten draught beer towers.

anecdotes.text: An October 2023 visitor found about 80% of the room from overseas, with a Japanese bartender explaining the beers in fluent English.
A December 2024 guest, unsure of the name after asking twice, finally read it off the sign outside: Man in the Moon.
A September 2026 pub-goer found the fish and chips, tartar sauce included, excellent and adopted it as a new favourite.

kyoto_gion_okumura.notes: [Kaiseki-style French · Gion, off Hanamikoji] French cooking served like kaiseki in a quiet Gion house of private rooms: a caviar tart, seasonal small plates, seafood seared on hot stones, fugu or wagyu, and a dessert selection you can pick freely from. About two and a half hours. Reservation only; 10% service charge; children welcome.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: Gion Okumura, kaiseki-style French cuisine, with an online shop. Per Tabelog: a reservation-only house of counter, tables and private rooms in Gion.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 regular, back after a long gap, found the house renovated — shoes now stay on and the downstairs tatami room is tables — missing the old ryotei air but praising the food.
A November 2025 diner spent two and a half hours over the course in a private room and greedily picked several desserts at the end.
A March 2025 guest, taken there by someone else, found the course disjointed and dated.

kyoto_feliz_maruto.gf_detail: Ask. Miso is the theme of every course, and some miso is barley-based (Oshima barley miso in a July 2026 tasting); the staff ask about restrictions before a course (September 2026).
kyoto_feliz_maruto.vegan_detail: Not vegan: sashimi, sea bass, pork, wagyu sukiyaki and duck in the courses (2026 reviews).

Lunch is courses only (official site). Reservations accepted; seat-only bookings may be asked to take a course (Tabelog). Seat-only bookings are charged ¥715 incl. tax for a three-miso tasting starter, included in courses (Tabelog original 「席のみご予約」の場合、先付【御味噌の三種食べ比べ】715円(税込)を頂いております。). kyoto_feliz_maruto.notes: [Miso kaiseki · Takakura near Shijo-Karasuma, machiya] A townhouse restaurant that makes miso the star: each course opens with three regional misos to compare, then sashimi, sea bass grilled with miso and sansho, miso-marinated cheese and slow-cooked pork, ending with clay-pot rice and even a miso dessert. Courses from ¥4,000; private rooms. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: Feliz-團斗 (read まると), a Kyoto Japanese restaurant serving courses rich in miso and seasonal ingredients from ¥4,000; the site links a sister ramen shop, 麺処RAMEN まると, opened in 2023 near Kiyomizu-dera. Opened 21 March 2018 (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 company party used the private rooms and enjoyed a Gion Matsuri scene drawn in miso powder and the chance to choose the miso for the soup.
A July 2026 diner on the ¥5,500 Otowa course tasted a Kyoto rice-koji miso, a Yamaguchi barley miso and a red miso side by side.
A September 2026 holiday lunch guest was asked about dislikes and restrictions even though it was a set course.

kyoto_momoya_kushiage_nishiki.notes: [Kushiage izakaya · Nishiki behind Daimaru, skewers from lunchtime] A stylish, smoky little izakaya off Nishiki serving carefully fried skewers — a six-piece set is about ¥1,400 — with Nishiki-market sashimi, obanzai lunch sets and cheap highballs from 11:30. Popular; book at night. Smoking allowed. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Run by 株式会社グラマラスフード (daniels.jp), whose ダニエルズ Italian shops are hidden in this app as a chain; 桃屋 is a separate brand with two shops (桃屋 and 桃屋 錦), and January 2026 reviewers describe it as part of the Daniels group. August 2026: "In a time when Nishiki Market is seeing a surge of overpriced and low-quality establishments catering to tourists, 'Momoya' stands out as a rare gem—affordable and tranquil."

kyoto_shinya_shokudo_kochan_gion.notes: [Late-night izakaya · north Gion, a one-man counter till 4 am] A Shinya Shokudo-style eight-seat counter off Hanamikoji where one young owner cooks sashimi, oden, braised tongue and late katsudon until 4 am. kyoto_nagomi_teppan_zoronpa_sanjo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: sashimi, steak, seafood and egg dishes (2024–2026 reviews).

kyoto_nagomi_teppan_zoronpa_sanjo.notes: [Teppan izakaya · Yanaginobanba below Sanjo, okonomiyaki and fresh fish] A warm two-storey teppan izakaya with sashimi, Wagyu rump steak, fluffy tartar okonomiyaki and chijimi, plus private rooms upstairs; staff are chatty in a good way, reviewers say. ¥600 appetizer. chef_bio.background: A sister of 串鉄板ぞろんぱ 室町仏光寺店, which is already in this app; Tabelog lists Zoronpa shops elsewhere in Kyoto, and this one is a corporate-member listing. kyoto_yoshimura_daimaru_bettei.vegan_detail: Not vegan: bonito-dashi tsuyu, tempura sets and tuna dishes (2024–2026 reviews).

kyoto_yoshimura_daimaru_bettei.notes: [Soba · Daimaru Kyoto 8F, the Arashiyama Yoshimura group's city branch] A calm department-store branch of the Arashiyama soba house: handmade soba with the day's buckwheat origin explained, a good-value Daimaru Zen set with mini tendon, a three-soba tasting, and soba sweets in the afternoon. chef_bio.background: Part of the よしむら group (yoshimura-gr.com), whose main shop is Arashiyama Yoshimura near Togetsukyo, with 蕎麦の実 よしむら (Karasuma Gojo) and 北之蔵 よしむら北山楼; an October 2026 reviewer says the Daimaru branch opened about three years ago. chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: よしむら 大丸京都別邸、そば・居酒屋・スイーツ、下京区四条通高倉西入立売西町79 大丸京都店 8F、阪急烏丸駅・地下鉄四条駅から地下直結、毎日 11:00〜16:00・17:00〜21:00、1月1・2日休み、14:30〜16:00はそばスイーツのカフェと一品そば、繁忙期は特別メニュー、予約可、53席、禁煙、車椅子可、カード可、電子マネー・QR不可。公式サイト (よしむらグループ): 嵐山よしむら、蕎麦の実 よしむら、北之蔵 よしむら北山楼。口コミ (2024年10月〜2026年10月、英語): 大丸膳 (そば、ミニ天丼、小鉢) 1,780円、3種のそばの食べ比べ、限定の田舎そば、十割そば、その日のそば粉の産地 (秋田など) を教えてくれる、温かい海老天そば (天ぷらとねぎは別皿)、天おろしそば、そばの実のサラダ、まぐろとやまかけのそばの実、そばスイーツ、京都の柚子ソーダとそばかりんとう、開店から約3年 (2026年10月)、有名なチェーンの一つという声 (2026年8月)。
